name: FormCraft
description: FormCraft is a self-hosted form builder: a drag-and-drop builder with 10 field types and templates, quizzes with scoring, a submissions table with filters, charts and CSV export, users and roles, email and Telegram alerts, multilingual forms (English, Arabic, Tamil) with right-to-left support, light and dark themes, and full system backups. DATABASE: this template uses the built-in SQLite database, stored in the Data folder below. Nothing else to install. To use PostgreSQL instead, set Database URL to postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DBNAME?schema=public (create the empty database first; the tables build themselves on first start). First run: open the WebUI and create your admin account. There is no default password.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: SQLite database, uploaded logos and cover images, and restore snapshots. Keep this folder in your backups.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port you open FormCraft on.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Leave as is for SQLite. For PostgreSQL use postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/formcraft?schema=public

variables.name: Demo data
variables.description: Load 4 demo forms with sample responses into an empty database.

variables.name: Per-form port range
variables.description: Optional, e.g. 4001-4010: every form gets its own port that serves only that form. Also add each port to the container (or use Host networking).

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the Data folder (99 = nobody on Unraid).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the Data folder (100 = users on Unraid).
